The '''giant rat''' is a monster found in [[Daemonheim]], released as part of the [[dungeoneering]] skill. It is relatively weak compared to other monsters found in [[Daemonheim]], and can be found on any floor. The rats found in the upper levels of [[Daemonheim]] have the same appearance as the giant rats in [[Varrock sewers]]. On the other hand, those found in warped floors have bodies composed partially of what appears to be magma, ostensibly due to the twisted magic therein.
